function.description: This function is used to create a recommendation model using a given user data and an algorithm type Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

user_data.description: A data frame of user ratings. Rows represent users, columns represent items, and entries represent user ratings for items

algorithm.description: The algorithm to be used for creating the recommendation model. Collaborative filtering, content-based filtering and hybrid filtering.

matrix_factorization.description: Optional parameter to indicate whether matrix factorization should be used. Default is False.

message.content: Below is a **step‑by‑step guide** that covers everything you’ll need to build a modern, production‑ready frontend for an e‑commerce site. Feel free to skip sections that already apply to you, or dive deeper into the parts that are new. --- ## 1️⃣ Planning & Design | Step | What to Do | Why It Matters | |------|------------|----------------| | **Define Goals** | List core features (product catalog, cart, checkout, search, filters, reviews, admin panel). | Keeps scope focused. | | **User Personas** | Sketch typical shoppers (e.g., “Budget Buyer”, “Tech Enthusiast”). | Guides UX decisions. | | **Wireframes** | Low‑fidelity sketches of key pages (home, product, cart, checkout). | Visualise layout early. | | **Prototypes** | Interactive mockups (Figma, Adobe XD). | Validate flow before coding. | | **Design System** | Create reusable components, color palette, typography, spacing. | Consistency & speed. | > **Tip:** Use Figma’s “Design Tokens” plugin to export design values directly into your codebase. --- ## 2️⃣ Tech Stack Choices | Layer | Options | Recommendation | |-------|---------|----------------| | **Framework** | React, Vue, Angular | **React** + **Next.js** (SSR + SSG) for SEO & performance. | | **State Management** | Redux Toolkit, Zustand, Recoil | **Redux Toolkit** (simple, well‑documented). | | **Styling** | CSS Modules, Styled‑Components, Tailwind CSS | **Tailwind CSS** (utility‑first, fast prototyping). | | **Component Library** | Material‑UI, Ant Design, Chakra UI | **Chakra UI** (accessibility out‑of‑the‑box). | | **Routing** | React Router, Next.js Router | **Next.js Router** (built‑in). | | **Data Fetching** | SWR, React Query | **React Query** (caching, background refetch). | | **Testing** | Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress | **Jest + RTL** for unit, **Cypress** for end‑to‑end. | | **Linting/Formatting** | ESLint, Prettier | **ESLint + Prettier** (shareable configs). | | **CI/CD** | GitHub Actions, CircleCI, GitLab CI | **GitHub Actions** (free, integrated). | | **Deployment** | Vercel, Netlify, AWS Amplify | **Vercel** (Next.js optimized). | | **Analytics** | Google Analytics, Plausible, Segment | **Google Analytics 4** (free, robust). | | **Monitoring** | Sentry, LogRocket | **Sentry** (error tracking). | > **Why Next.js?** > • Server‑side rendering → instant page loads, better SEO. > • Static site generation → pre‑render product pages. > • Built‑in API routes → simple backend integration. --- ## 3️⃣ Project Skeleton ```bash npx create-next-app@latest ecommerce-frontend cd ecommerce-frontend npm install @reduxjs/toolkit react-redux tailwindcss@latest postcss@latest autoprefixer@latest @chakra-ui/react @emotion/react @emotion/styled framer-motion react-query ``` ### Tailwind Setup ```bash npx tailwindcss init -p ``` Add to `tailwind.config.js`: ```js module.exports = { content: [ "./pages/**/*.{js,ts,jsx,tsx}", "./components/**/*.{js,ts,jsx,tsx}", ], theme: { extend: {}, }, plugins: [], } ``` Add to `globals.css`: ```css @tailwind base; @tailwind components; @tailwind utilities; ``` ### Redux Toolkit Store ```ts // store.ts import { configureStore } from '@reduxjs/toolkit'; import cartReducer from './slices/cartSlice'; export const store = configureStore({ reducer: { cart: cartReducer, }, }); export type RootState = ReturnType; export type AppDispatch = typeof store.dispatch; ``` ### React Query Provider ```tsx // _app.tsx import { QueryClient, QueryClientProvider } from '@tanstack/react-query'; import { ChakraProvider } from '@chakra-ui/react'; import { Provider } from 'react-redux'; import { store } from '../store'; const queryClient = new QueryClient(); export default function MyApp({ Component, pageProps }) { return ( ); } ``` --- ## 4️⃣ Core Features Implementation | Feature | Key Components | Data Flow | |---------|----------------|-----------| | **Product Listing** | `ProductGrid`, `ProductCard` | Fetch via React Query → display paginated list. | | **Search & Filters** | `SearchBar`, `FilterSidebar` | Query params → API call → update URL. | | **Product Detail** | `ProductPage`, `ImageGallery`, `ReviewSection` | SSR/SSG → fetch product by slug. | | **Cart** | `CartIcon`, `CartDrawer`, `CartItem` | Redux store → localStorage sync. | | **Checkout** | `CheckoutForm`, `PaymentGateway` | Form validation → API call → redirect to payment. | | **User Auth** | `Login`, `Register`, `Profile` | JWT stored in HttpOnly cookie → protected routes. | | **Admin Panel** | `Dashboard`, `ProductManager`, `OrderManager` | Role‑based access → API routes. | ### Example: Product Card ```tsx // components/ProductCard.tsx import { Box, Image, Text, Button } from '@chakra-ui/react'; import Link from 'next/link'; import { useDispatch } from 'react-redux'; import { addToCart } from '../store/slices/cartSlice'; export const ProductCard = ({ product }) => { const dispatch = useDispatch(); const handleAdd = () => { dispatch(addToCart({ id: product.id, quantity: 1 })); }; return ( {product.title} ${product.price} ); }; ``` --- ## 5️⃣ Performance Optimizations | Technique | How | |-----------|-----| | **Code Splitting** | Next.js automatically splits per page. | | **Image Optimization** | Use `next/image` component. | | **Lazy Loading** | `loading="lazy"` on images, dynamic imports. | | **Tree Shaking** | ES modules + bundler. | | **Prefetching** | Next.js `prefetch` on ``. | | **Service Worker** | PWA support via `next-pwa`. | | **CDN** | Vercel CDN + Cloudflare Images. | --- ## 6️⃣ Accessibility & SEO | Checklist | Tool | |-----------|------| | **ARIA Labels** | Manual review | | **Keyboard Navigation** | Axe, Lighthouse | | **Color Contrast** | Contrast Checker | | **Meta Tags** | Next.js `Head` component | | **Structured Data** | JSON‑LD via `next-seo` | | **Sitemap** | `next-sitemap` plugin | | **Robots.txt** | `next-sitemap` | --- ## 7️⃣ Testing Strategy | Type | Tool | Example | |------|------|---------| | **Unit** | Jest + React Testing Library | Test component rendering. | | **Integration** | Cypress | End‑to‑end checkout flow. | | **Snapshot** | Jest | Verify UI changes. | | **Accessibility** | Cypress + axe | Run accessibility tests. | ### Sample Unit Test ```tsx // __tests__/ProductCard.test.tsx import { render, screen } from '@testing-library/react'; import { ProductCard } from '../components/ProductCard'; test('renders product title', () => { const product = { id: 1, title: 'Test Product', price: 9.99, image: '/test.jpg', slug: 'test-product' }; render(); expect(screen.getByText(/Test Product/i)).toBeInTheDocument(); }); ``` --- ## 8️⃣ Deployment Pipeline 1. **Push to GitHub** → GitHub Actions trigger. 2. **Lint & Test** → `npm run lint && npm run test`. 3. **Build** → `npm run build`. 4. **Deploy** → Vercel auto‑deploy on push. 5. **Post‑Deploy** → Run smoke tests, send Slack notification. > **GitHub Actions Sample** ```yaml name: CI/CD on: push: branches: [main] pull_request: branches: [main] jobs: build-test: runs-on: ubuntu-latest steps: - uses: actions/checkout@v3 - uses: actions/setup-node@v3 with: node-version: '20' - run: npm ci - run: npm run lint - run: npm run test - run: npm run build - uses: amondnet/vercel-action@v20 with: vercel-token: ${{ secrets.VERCEL_TOKEN }} vercel-org-id: ${{ secrets.VERCEL_ORG_ID }} vercel-project-id: ${{ secrets.VERCEL_PROJECT_ID }} vercel-args: '--prod' ``` --- ## 9️⃣ Security Checklist | Area | Best Practice | |------|---------------| | **Auth** | JWT in HttpOnly cookie, CSRF token. | | **API** | Rate limiting, input validation. | | **XSS** | Escape user input, CSP header. | | **HTTPS** | Enforce TLS, HSTS. | | **Secrets** | Store in GitHub Secrets, use Vault. | | **Dependencies** | Dependabot alerts, lockfile. | --- ## 🔟 Resources & Learning Paths | Topic | Resource | |-------|----------| | **React Basics** | Official React Docs | | **Next.js** | Next.js Docs, Vercel Blog | | **Tailwind CSS** | Tailwind Docs, Tailwind Play | | **Redux Toolkit** | Redux Docs | | **React Query** | React Query Docs | | **Testing** | Testing Library Docs, Cypress Docs | | **Accessibility** | WCAG Guidelines, axe DevTools | | **SEO** | Google Search Central, Next.js SEO | | **PWA** | MDN PWA Guide, next-pwa | --- ## 📌 Quick Checklist for Launch - ✅ All core pages built & styled - ✅ API integration working (products, cart, checkout) - ✅ Auth flow (login, register, profile) - ✅ Admin panel (CRUD products, view orders) - ✅ Responsive design (mobile, tablet, desktop) - ✅ Accessibility audit passed - ✅ SEO meta tags & structured data added - ✅ Performance score > 90 (Lighthouse) - ✅ Unit & E2E tests passing - ✅ CI pipeline configured - ✅ Deployment to Vercel (or chosen host) - ✅ Monitoring & error tracking set up --- ### Final Thought Building a full‑featured e‑commerce frontend is a marathon, not a sprint. Start small (MVP), iterate based on real user feedback, and keep the codebase clean with solid tooling. Happy coding! 🚀
